## Patient: Priya

**Date:** 2023-10-27

**HPI:** 36-year-old male presenting with seropositive rheumatoid arthritis (RA) exhibiting erosive joint changes. Reports morning stiffness exceeding 1 hour, symmetric MCP joint swelling, and elevated anti-CCP levels at 250 U/mL.

**Physical Exam:**  Patient demonstrates bilateral MCP joint swelling upon palpation.  Limited range of motion in both joints.  Observe for signs of systemic inflammation.

**Management Plan:** Initiate NSAID therapy as prescribed. Monitor for exacerbations, including pain and swelling. Consider referral to rheumatologist for further evaluation and potential disease-modifying oral medications.  Continue physical therapy to maintain joint mobility.
